mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT od.order_id) FROM order_details od JOIN order o ON od.order_id = o.order_id JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id WHERE od.order_status = '대기' AND s.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT od.order_id) FROM order_details od JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.order_id JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id WHERE od.order_stauts = '승인' AND s.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT od.order_id) FROM order_details od JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.order_id JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id WHERE od.order_stauts = '거절' AND s.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY o.order_id) AS row_no, o.order_id, o.order_at, s.store_name, AS order_summary, o.total_price, AS display_status, MAX(od.store_at) AS store_at FROM orders o JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id JOIN order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id JOIN ingredients i ON od.ingredient_id = i.ingredient_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY o.order_id, o.order_at, s.store_name, o.total_price ORDER BY o.order_id

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY o.order_id) AS row_no, o.order_id, o.order_at, s.store_name, AS order_summary, o.total_price, AS display_status, MAX(od.store_at) AS store_at FROM orders o JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id JOIN order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id JOIN ingredients i ON od.ingredient_id = i.ingredient_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId}
AND CAST(o.order_id AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND s.store_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND (CAST(o.order_id AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND o.order_at >= #{startDate} AND o.order_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY o.order_id, o.order_at, s.store_name, o.total_price HAVING 1 = 1
AND display_status = #{displayStatus}
AND MAX(od.store_at) >= #{startDate} AND MAX(od.store_at) < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
ORDER BY o.order_id
mapper.update: UPDATE order o JOIN order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id SET od.order_status = #{status}, od.reject_reason = #{reason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, od.app_at = NOW(), o.app_at = NOW() WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId} AND od.order_status = '대기' AND s.user_id = #{userId} AND #{status} IN ('승인', '거절')
